method_files.strategy.md:
---
name: event-strategy
package: fixture-methods@1
---

Match the event date and stage to issuer evidence. Distinguish an information difference from an event merely being scheduled. Compare the candidate with the relevant existing alternative using matching periods, prices, assumptions and material counterevidence. For a call debit spread, identify same underlying and expiry, ordered strikes, the net debit, contract multiplier, executable bid/ask and liquidity before computing a specific payoff. At expiry, per-contract maximum payoff before premium is strike width times multiplier; maximum loss is net debit times multiplier plus costs, assuming the spread remains intact and its exercise/assignment obligations are managed. Before expiry prices also depend on volatility and time. American short options can be assigned early, creating temporary stock, funding and management requirements. Missing verified contracts, quotes, expiry or broker rules limits concrete sizing and implementation, not a supported explanation of the mechanism. Never infer new-strategy validation from the held-options account tool. Scenario outputs are conditional, not success probabilities or authorization to trade.
